title: Introducing Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, empowering all users with its powerful new insights and capabilities.

title: Complete File Control in Your Editor
summary: Now, you can seamlessly organize, upload, and tailor the presentation of all your files and images directly within the editor for a more powerful content creation experience.

title: Interactive Public Roadmap
summary: Stay up-to-date with our progress, upcoming features, and future plans through our newly launched, interactive public roadmap page.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a more seamless experience with checkboxes that are now easier to click, drag, and perfectly match our modern design.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly upgraded our editor to provide a seamless and more intuitive co-editing experience, empowering teams to work together with unprecedented ease.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Discovery
summary: We've made it easier than ever to share your ideas and quests, ensuring all relevant content is effortlessly discoverable and visible within your network.

title: Worldwide Language Accessibility
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out extensive international language support, connecting users across the globe.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: We're opening Noeko's codebase to empower you with maximum control, foster community collaboration, and ensure complete transparency in its ongoing development.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Transform your visual knowledge map into a powerful workflow starter by filtering connections with tags and time, and effortlessly sharing your insights with others.

title: Power Search & Custom Knowledge Collections
summary: Experience a smarter search with powerful filtering and sorting tools, enabling you to effortlessly discover and curate your most relevant information into personalized knowledge collections.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: Experience a more fluid and organized workspace with enhanced content views that bring your linked ideas, tasks, and sources to life.

title: Noeko Launch: Empowering Your Workflow with Flexible Deployment Options
summary: Experience Noeko's full potential with our new launch, featuring versatile self-hosting capabilities and premium cloud-hosted plans designed to scale with your ambitions.

title: Unleash Your Style with Expanded Theme Options
summary: Prepare to transform your workspace with a diverse collection of beautiful new themes and significant improvements to our current designs, offering unparalleled personalization.

title: Precise Daily Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more accurate and thoughtful welcome with updated greetings that precisely match the time of day.

title: Effortless Tag Management
summary: Streamline your workflow with the ability to instantly remove items from tags right within your tag list, making organization a breeze.

title: Expand Your Knowledge with Diverse Content Formats
summary: Get ready to effortlessly capture and engage with a wider universe of information, from YouTube videos to websites, all within your personalized knowledge hub.
